prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Save Your New Desktop Companion", "Create or log into your account to store your pet safe in the cloud."]
1: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion", "Select Companion"]
2: ["How to Interact With Your Pet", "Right-click your desktop pet anytime to access hide, summon, and pet settings."]
3: ["Bright, clear lighting ensures your custom pet is generated correctly."]
4: ["Preparing Your Pet's New Home...", "Your pet is packing its bags and getting ready to move onto your desktop!"]
5: ["Always log in with the same account method to preserve your saved pets and progress."]
6: ["Choose Your Path & Claim Starter Item", "Pick how you want to create your pet and receive a free pet hat accessory!", "Free Starter Accessory Included"]
7: ["You will receive a desktop notification as soon as your pet is ready!"]
8: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Review your pet companion details and sign to welcome them home."]
9: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Look at the taskbar tray or screen corner. Click the tray icon if your pet is hiding.", "Meet My Pet"]
